acquisition: The illustrative source record describes an authenticated LINZ Data Service workflow. A production connector must preserve the exact layer metadata, request/service parameters, response headers and raw bytes before emitting a completed capture event.
exclusions: No real source payloads, council planning instruments, facilities or health outcomes are included.
harmonisation: The illustrative transformation declares a target CRS and geometry-repair policy but performs no bundled real-data transformation.
spatial_handling: The example declares EPSG:2193 as the canonical analysis CRS and distinguishes source geometry from canonical geometry.
temporal_handling: Retrieval time is recorded separately from valid or legal effective time. This example has no evidenced operative date and therefore makes no legal-status claim.
missing_data: Absent valid-time and legal-status evidence are retained as unknown rather than imputed.
quality_notes: The warning is intentional: schema and geometry validity do not establish legal temporal validity.
governance: No Māori-specific data are included in this synthetic example. The production source registry must evaluate Māori data sovereignty triggers for derived geographic and health products.
privacy: No personal or sensitive unit-record data are included in the synthetic example.
reproducibility: The illustrative GeoParquet materialisation is classified R2: semantic reconstruction is expected, but byte identity has not been demonstrated.
software_hardware: The example records package, commit, runtime, platform, lockfile and container identity fields; values marked synthetic are not execution evidence.
stochasticity: The illustrative transformation is declared deterministic at the semantic level and uses no random seed.
ai_assistance: The architecture and example were prepared with AI assistance; all normative contracts, source claims and release evidence require human review before stable publication.
limitations: The example contains metadata records only and no genuine source geometry.
The recorded hash values and code commit are synthetic placeholders.
No council plan or legal operative status is represented.
